agent-instructions.objective: Create one clinic appointment for the verified patient. Resolve the provider, verify insurance eligibility for the service (or record an explicit self-pay choice), find an open slot, confirm the exact slot with the patient, then commit the booking through the provider schedule. If the desired slot is no longer open, offer the nearest alternates rather than booking a different time silently.

verifiable-behavior.fizzbee:
--- deadlock_detection: false liveness: "false" options: max_concurrent_actions: 1 ---
# ---- State ---- action Init: provider_resolved = False eligibility_checked = False eligible = oneof [True, False] # coverage verdict from insurer self_pay = oneof [True, False] # patient opted to self-pay slot_selected = False slot_available = oneof [True, False] # is the chosen slot still open booking_confirmed = False appointment_booked = False alternate_offered = False
atomic action ResolveProvider: require not provider_resolved provider_resolved = True
# ---- Eligibility gate (insurer verdict; may be eligible or not) ---- atomic action CheckEligibility: require provider_resolved require not eligibility_checked eligibility_checked = True
atomic action SelectSlot: require provider_resolved require not slot_selected slot_selected = True
# ---- Patient confirms the exact slot ---- atomic action ConfirmBooking: require slot_selected require eligibility_checked require eligible or self_pay require not booking_confirmed booking_confirmed = True
# ---- Commit (models the schedule accepting or rejecting the write) ---- atomic action CreateBooking: require not appointment_booked require provider_resolved require eligibility_checked require eligible or self_pay require slot_selected require slot_available require booking_confirmed appointment_booked = oneof [True, False]
# ---- Fallback: chosen slot is taken -> offer alternates, never silently rebook ---- atomic action OfferAlternate: require slot_selected require not slot_available require not appointment_booked alternate_offered = True
# ---- Invariants ---- always assertion EligibilityBeforeBooking: return (not appointment_booked) or eligibility_checked
always assertion CoveredOrSelfPay: return (not appointment_booked) or eligible or self_pay
# A booking is never committed to a slot that is not available (no double-book). always assertion NoDoubleBook: return (not appointment_booked) or slot_available
always assertion ConfirmBeforeBooking: return (not appointment_booked) or booking_confirmed

promises.description: Book one clinic appointment for the verified patient: resolve provider, verify insurance eligibility (or self-pay), find an open slot, confirm it, and commit. Never double-books a taken slot and never books before eligibility and confirmation are settled; offers alternates when the slot is gone.

offer.body: Book one appointment for the verified patient with the resolved provider at a confirmed open slot. Kept only when every gate below holds.
The promised fallback: when the chosen slot is no longer open, offer the nearest available slots and let the patient pick — never silently book a different time.
A slot is never booked twice; the commit is refused by the provider schedule if the slot was taken since it was offered (NoDoubleBook, kept in code regardless of the model).
No appointment is booked until insurance eligibility has been checked and the service is covered, or the patient explicitly chooses self-pay (EligibilityBeforeBooking, CoveredOrSelfPay).

use.body: The verified patient the booking is for; the registry publishes it, this agent never changes who is active.
The insurer's point-in-time coverage verdict for the service; a non-eligible verdict forces an explicit self-pay choice.
The provider's currently open slots; a slot is only bookable while it appears here.
Commits the appointment to the schedule with an idempotency key; the schedule refuses a slot taken in the meantime.
The patient confirms the exact provider, date, and time before the appointment is created.

step-guidance.binding: Call list_providers and match the patient's request (by name or specialty). If ambiguous, ask which; never guess.

Call check_eligibility with the patient's plan and the service. If the verdict is not eligible, tell the patient and ask whether they want to proceed self-pay; do not continue until eligibility is checked AND the service is covered or self-pay is chosen.
Call list_open_slots for the provider and present real open times. Only times returned here are selectable.

step-guidance.confirm: State the exact provider, date, and time and ask the patient to confirm. Do not create the booking until they confirm the specific slot.

step-guidance.binding: Call create_booking(patient, provider, slot, idempotency_key). If it returns a slot_taken refusal, the slot was booked since it was offered — do NOT retry blindly; go to OfferAlternate.
step-guidance.on-success: Confirm the appointment (provider, date, time) and note any self-pay choice.

step-guidance.binding: When create_booking refuses (slot taken) or the slot is no longer listed, present the nearest open slots and let the patient choose. Never book a different time without the patient selecting it.

agent-instructions.enforcement: The service layer enforces these independently of the model, before the commit: create_booking refuses to write a slot that is already taken. create_booking refuses unless eligibility was checked and the service is covered or self_pay was chosen. create_booking refuses unless the patient confirmed the specific slot.

responses.not-covered: Your plan doesn't appear to cover [service] as of today. You can proceed self-pay (estimated [amount]) — would you like to? (yes / no)
responses.slot-taken: That [time] slot with [provider] was just taken. The nearest openings are: [alternates]. Which works for you?
responses.booked: You're booked: [provider], [date] at [time]. [If self-pay: This is a self-pay appointment.] You'll get a reminder before the visit.
responses.error: I couldn't complete the booking. Details: [api_error]. Your appointment was not created.
